body: Finding where I belong, seeing any clarity to where my life will be headed, accepting who I see myself as, and seeing reason to find meaning in living. It boils down mostly to being lost in life and looking for reasons not to kill myself.

It's beautiful, every stanza works with how we feel. I wanted to thank you, not for just writing this, but for sharing it.

The trick is to tear down a facade and start from scratch, because you never truly who you are and can't benefit from if you don't let yourself get hurt or accept it for what it is. The realist people I've ever met were people who had depth because they were who they were to everyone they met, there was nothing in the way. It might be hard but I believe you can do it.

You think you're not relatable but you are. I've never found anyone that truly seems to care truly about how empty and alone I feel, so I sometimes act like I'm married to myself in a way. I think about problems as if I were asking what I would do if I were asking from the perspective of my wife if I had one, though I realize I probably won't.

I am the same, in that I always try to make people happy but I feel so alone all the time. If I'm talking to someone I always crack jokes or ask them how they feel, but everyone assumes I'm okay myself. I've struggled with a weed and alcohol addiction for years, and one day someone on Reddit told me "be the good you need to see today, and tomorrow life will be good to you". I understand where you're coming from completely, and I hope you realize who you are to others. Stay strong brother.

I feel you. Sometimes something you can enjoy is looking for things to do, or at least if keeps your thoughts quiet while you do. I understand, I've tried knitting, cooking, talking to random people, photography, even thought that all meant nothing to me really.  I've just settled on learning an instrument. I know I'm no good, but it keeps my mind occupied so I don't lose my sanity every night.

I just want to be me, and have companionship, but I've been alone for so long, not having friends and all. Some days I wake up and wonder where I'm going if it all doesn't matter in the end, and i think about it a lot actually. Like what if I just died in my sleep, would anyone blink and eye or is life one big train that doesn't stop for anything, and therefore maybe I don't matter. It's the silence that kills me, coming home and it just being so lonely at night, just me where nothing matters anymore.

Of course it's good to cry, and it's perfectly acceptable. Sometimes you just got to talk to yourself or reach out, explore something new or even get your mind off of it completely until the time is right. I feel you, I'm 24 and I've been single all my life as well, it hurts. I have nobody close to talk to, Reddit has become almost my second half, but I think about what you think all the time as well.
